customer_reply:
Hello,

We’ve identified that the OCR failures you’re seeing (error E‑4102) are due to a known issue affecting the eInvoice module after the recent 26.2.3 release. Our engineering team is actively working on a hot‑fix (see incident INC‑26‑0418). We’ve escalated this as a P1 incident and our L2 engineers are on it. We’ll keep you updated with progress and an estimated resolution time.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
Support Team
